main_text.l: bergensis R.P. à Consiliis, verę Reli-

l.i: Attamen, ecce, tua Beza am obmutescere morte,
Quidnam igitur nunc Beza tuum? quod scilicet
Nec tamè innumeras numeris coprendere laudes
Innumeris Verùm lacrymis tua funera plangit,
Nam quæ te Pietas simul & Doctrina corona
Quam Vereor tumulo obruerit Germania tecum,

page.notes: The first word of the verse is a large initial "C" (Conari); the initial letter is partly obscured. Several words in the verse are doubtful, notably "Beza" forms and the abbreviation marks over "Nec", "Pietas" and "Quam". Underlining and marks in the scan are not text.
